# Kaldemor Gauntlet

*Drillmaster Quill's course for those who want to be tested: a yard full of monsters, a course of moving platforms, spikes and falling rocks, and a last stand. Potions work in there; scrolls do not.*

Dying ends the run.

## 1. The Training Yard

Map: [The Training Yard](../maps/gauntlet_yard.md)

- Defeat every monster

Wave 1: 3 [Pig](../monsters/pig.md), 3 [Orange Mushroom](../monsters/orange_mushroom.md)

Wave 2: 3 [Green Mushroom](../monsters/green_mushroom.md), 2 [Stump](../monsters/stump.md)

Wave 3: 3 [Green Mushroom](../monsters/green_mushroom.md), 2 [Stump](../monsters/stump.md), 3 [Pig](../monsters/pig.md)

## 2. The Hanging Course

Map: [The Hanging Course](../maps/gauntlet_course.md). Time limit: 150 s.

- Collect 3 Star Shards
- Reach the far ledge

## 3. The Last Stand

Map: [The Last Stand](../maps/gauntlet_holdout.md)

- Survive for 60 seconds

Wave 1: 2 [Green Mushroom](../monsters/green_mushroom.md), 1 [Pig](../monsters/pig.md)

## Rewards (Normal)

First clear: 1,500 EXP, [Agent Cape](../items/agent_cape.md) x1, [Elixir](../items/elixir.md) x2, Unlocks `kaldemor.gauntlet_cleared`

Every clear: 2,000 mesos, [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x5, [White Potion](../items/white_potion.md) x3
